task: Binary validity of a supplied sentence/entity-pair/relation label; positive class = noise
primary_model_selection: Minimum mean inner out-of-fold log loss; tie smaller C; same rule for every learned model
threshold_selection: Separate NA/non-NA thresholds; maximize noise recall subject to clean retention >= target on INNER predictions; threshold constraint is empirical, not a population guarantee. Recall90 is historical aggressive-policy comparator.
splitting: StratifiedGroupKFold; normalize and hash full sentence; all mentions of same normalized sentence together; fit vocab/scalers only on training folds
data_handling: Read official ARNOR 2.0 raw files; strict unique entity spans; remove exact duplicate sentence/pair/relation annotations; quarantine inconsistent labels and unknown labels; keep original files unchanged
promotion: Context LR must improve pooled development OOF noise recall over rule LR under retain90, with clean retention no more than 2 percentage points lower and >=0.88 in both NA/non-NA groups. Otherwise retain rule LR as default and report negative result.
test_use: Official dev/test were previously examined in this project; no pristine holdout claimed. Test opened for this run only AFTER all final model/policy configs and development selection are saved; no test-driven revision or tuning.
scope: Post-course extension; not a neural SOTA claim; no downstream relation-extraction improvement implied by noise metrics
